# Brainscape

> > Brainscape is an AI-powered spaced repetition flashcard platform offering expert-curated study materials for entrance exams, professional certifications, medical training, and language learning.

Brainscape provides certified flashcards and adaptive learning tools designed to help students master complex subjects through scientifically-proven spaced repetition techniques. The platform covers diverse domains including medical certifications (NCLEX-RN, NREMT), entrance exams (AP, A-Level, GCSE), professional credentials (Bar Exam, TOEFL), and language acquisition.

## Key Topics

## Getting Started

- [Brainscape: The Best Flashcards App | Make Flashcards Online](https://www.brainscape.com): Homepage showcasing spaced repetition flashcard platform with AI-powered learning capabilities and adaptive study tools.
- [Sign Up To Brainscape](https://www.brainscape.com/sign-up): Account registration page for Brainscape with social login via Apple and Google.

## Certified Flashcards Library

- [Brainscape Certified Flashcards](https://www.brainscape.com/learn): Expert-verified certified flashcards for test prep (NREMT, NCLEX-RN, GRE) and comprehensive subject mastery.
- [Brainscape Certified Flashcards](https://www.brainscape.com/subjects): Directory of expert-created certified flashcards organized by subject and exam type for easy discovery.

## Test Prep & Entrance Exams

- [Study Flashcards for Entrance Exam Prep](https://www.brainscape.com/subjects/entrance-exams): Entrance exam prep flashcards for A-Levels, AP, GCSE, BTEC Sport and similar certification exams with expert curation.
- [Professional Certifications Flashcards | Certification Study Aid](https://www.brainscape.com/subjects/professional-certifications): Professional certification flashcards for Bar Exam, MPRE, TOEFL and IT/finance domains with comprehensive coverage.

## Medical & Healthcare Training

- [Medical Flashcards | Online Nursing Flashcards](https://www.brainscape.com/subjects/medical-nursing): Nursing and medical flashcards for anatomy, terminology and certification exam preparation including NCLEX-RN and NREMT.

## Academic Subjects & Language Learning

- [Science Study Materials | Genetics, Geology & More](https://www.brainscape.com/subjects/science): STEM science flashcards covering biology, chemistry, physics and certification exams with expert-curated content.
- [English | Reading, Writing & Literature](https://www.brainscape.com/subjects/english): English language flashcards for grammar, writing, literature analysis and ESL learning with comprehensive coverage.
- [Foreign Language Flashcards | Learn New Languages](https://www.brainscape.com/subjects/foreign-languages): Language learning flashcards for Italian, German, Arabic and other languages with spaced repetition methodology.
